developing a system that can recognize spoken language given visual and auditory input.

we have developed a framework to integrate speech recognition and speech synthesis, which is called speech recognition and synthesis integration framework (SRSI) in short.
the synthesis of visual speech is a useful tool for studying human visual speech perception and for understanding human visual speech production.

speech synthesis can be used to help speech recognition.
